_comment: Suites that fail on main because they test behaviour the app has since changed. The runner reports them as KNOWN but does not fail. Fix the suite and remove it from this list; the runner tells you when one starts passing.

suites.session-rejoin-integration: Uses the removed session 'restore' action; also a join without a name now returns 'Enter your name.'.
suites.membership-integration: Expects 401 for a removed player's /api/game call; the API now returns 400.
suites.progression-integration: Expects routine /api/game polling to reconcile social records; polling no longer syncs them (commit acc385b).
suites.avatars-integration: Expects 2 players after two addDummy calls in a new sandbox; the sandbox now starts with seats already filled.
suites.sandbox-lobby-integration: Expects 5 recap players after ending a sandbox game; the recap now has 11.
suites.table-load-integration: The local worker drops the connection during the 1.3 MB legacy-state chat step.
